tei:div.tei:p: ༈ karma pa gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i gsung 'bum/ a/

1 sku gsum ngo sprod bzhugs/ 2 gnas lugs gsal byed ye shes sgron me bzhugs/ 3 spyir sgom chos rje rang byung rin po che'i zin thun bzhugs/ 4 phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid yig bzhugs/ 5 rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 6 rnal 'byor gsum gyi khrid yig bzhugs/ 7 mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i gsang ba'i mgur rdo rje'i tshig rkang sbas don lta ba'i mig 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ 8 ro snyoms sgang 'dril bzhugs/ 9 phyag rgya chen po gang gā ma'i sa bcad bzhugs/ 10 phyag rgya chen po gaṅgā ma'i 'grel pa bzhugs/ 11 rgyal po do ha'i sa bcad bzhugs/ 12 do ha mdzod kyi glu'i don gsal bar byed pa tshig gi rgyan dri ma med pa'i sgron me bzhugs/ 13 gcod bka' tshoms chen mo'i sa bcad bzhugs/ 14 zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul gyi khrid yig bzhugs/ 15 ma ṇi yi bstan bcos bzhugs/ 16 rdzogs pa chen po snying thig spros bcas kyi dbang lce btsun gyis mdzad pa bzhugs/ 17 nyams len lag khrid ma'i khrid ngo mtshar can bzhugs/ 18 sman gyi bstan bcos sman ming rgya mtsho bzhugs/ 19 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag snang ba bzhugs/ 20 lnga bsdus bza' lnga'i rtsis/ dh+ru ba 'pho ba/ phyi nang gi rtsis/ nyi khyim 'pho ba/ dh+ru ba sgra gcan 'pho ba dang bza' bsdus pa bcas bzhugs/ 21 rje rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i nges don phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam bzhugs/ 22 rlung dang rigs pa'i bcud len rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba bzhugs/ 23 chu 'thung ba'i gdam pa bzhugs/ 24 ra mo shag gi bcud len bzhugs/ 25 dam can skyes bu'i las byang dang mngon rtogs bzhugs/ 26 dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje rgyal po la gtor ba 'bul ba bzhugs/
